code_mechanism.update: normalized linear SGD: scale=0.5*(y-w·x)/||x||^2; w += scale*x
code_mechanism.choose: argmax (w·x, -tie_rank); choose does not consume RNG
code_mechanism.persist: PersistentAdaptive keeps weights and updates across tasks
code_mechanism.reset_task: ResetAdaptive.reset_task rebuilds AdaptiveProposer then restores tie_rank and rng_state; weights, updates, and feedback_seen clear
code_mechanism.forced_anchors: slots 0-1 are locked flat-IID-16 then successor-IID-16
code_mechanism.free_training_slots: slots 2-3, after two current-task SGD updates
code_mechanism.hidden_slots: two choose() calls on the full revealed set after training
